title: Department of Veterans Affairs: Phase 56O Remediation Follow-Through
summary: GAO reports that VA implemented two of twenty-nine prior priority recommendations, added three, and now has thirty priority recommendations across health-care access, IT modernization, and acquisition management. Phase 56O decision: Publish the exact portfolio movement without substituting it for iFAMS, Southern Oregon, enterprise FISMA, or veteran-outcome evidence.
key_findings: Exact record: GAO-26-108978 VA priority recommendation portfolio.
Status period: May 2025 baseline through May 2026.
Continuation rule: Reopen when GAO publishes the next VA priority letter or VA OIG changes the named iFAMS or Southern Oregon recommendation states.
why_it_matters: The record exposes implementation throughput and remaining remediation workload without converting a portfolio into a performance rate.
ftfn_relevance: Keeps implemented, added, de-prioritized, current, modeled, and realized states distinct.
Attaches source, period, scope, limitation, remaining gap, and continuation rule.
evidence_limits: The portfolio covers health care, IT modernization, and acquisition. It does not close the separate iFAMS or Southern Oregon actions or establish veteran, clinical, or enterprise-security outcomes.
Action-level closure evidence for the thirty priorities, the open iFAMS recommendations, and Southern Oregon recommendations 1, 2, 5, 6, and 7.
No ranking, composite, readiness score, performance rate, or causal claim is supported.
